S.FORM: alang Cihak ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Syuhong go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 995 buwan, 2,905 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 13% kyan ku 379 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 87% kyan ku 2,526 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 9%, Truku 1%, Tayan 1%, Bunun 1%. maki qu ngasal bziran, ngasal psatu tegami ru pqniqan iyu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Cihak hya' ga llyung. tay 'zil na Cihak hya' ga rgyax. tay mkyahu' na Cihak hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Cihak hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Cihak hya' ga Adetuman. rekisi kayal kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy maki 1 pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy. pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu [s|ɕ]juħoŋ ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa *** βuwan **** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku **** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] * truku * tajan * βunun * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran ŋa[s|ɕ]al p[s|ɕ]atu teɣami ru pqniqan iju rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj ʔzil na [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj mkjaħuʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na [ʦ|ʨ]iħak ħjaʔ ɣa a*etuman reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj maki * pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
